title: Model browse + compare toolbar prototype notes
body:
PURPOSE:
Quick, messy writeup of a compact "model browse + compare" toolbar concept that we can show in next product sync. Focus is on reducing friction when teams go from: open model catalog -> shortlist 2–3 candidates -> create endpoint (pin version optional) without leaving context.

SCOPE:
- Prototype only touches catalog list view and endpoint creation modal. No changes to billing/roles in this doc.
- Primary persona: backend ML engineer or full-stack PM creating a dev/test endpoint. Secondary: platform engineer creating reserved endpoints.

WHY:
- Current flow forces too many context switches: users open model pages, copy model ids, go to Create Endpoint flow, paste id, then hunt for version pin. We want inline compare and quick-create.

HIGH-LEVEL UX IDEA: toolbar docked to catalog list when 1+ models are selected.
- Left: compact pill area with selected model cards (thumbnail name, short perf tags: latency/cost/quality). Tap expands card for more details.
- Middle: "Compare" quick summary popup showing top diffs across metrics (median latency @128 tokens, token cost, SOTA notes, recommended use-cases).
- Right: actions: [Create endpoint ▸], [Pin version ▾], [Add to project].

WIREFRAME NOTES (sketch-level):
- Catalog list remains multi-column; selection uses subtle checkbox top-left of model card (not full row select).
- Toolbar appears as sticky footer above page controls once selection >=1. It is persistent across pages of results.
- Selected card macro content: model name (short), version (latest by default), 3 micro-metrics (latency/cost/embed-dim), 2 badges (open, rw-verified).

COMPARE POPUP:
- Triggered from "Compare" in toolbar or open from any selected card. 2–3 col layout: model name + version, short description (1 line), single-line metric rows.
- Microcopy for header: "Quick compare — side-by-side snapshot of selected models"
- Expand link: "View full model page" -> opens in new tab.

CREATE ENDPOINT FLOW (inline):
- Clicking [Create endpoint ▸] opens a compact modal anchored over the toolbar (no full page navigation).
- Modal steps (condensed inline wizard):
  1) Endpoint name (auto-suggest from first model: e.g., "summarize-dev-llama-2-13b") + editable namespace dropdown
  2) Capacity plan: radio buttons: Dev (1 shared vCPU), Staging (dedicated small), Prod (choose Dedicated) with short CPU/GPU hints. Microcopy: "Choose Dev for quick tests — no SLA. Pick Dedicated for production traffic."
  3) Version pinning: dropdown populated with compatible versions from selected model(s). Default behavior: if multiple models selected, prefill with first model's latest; show callout: "You can pin a specific version after creation — all endpoints default to latest unless pinned."
  4) Advanced (collapsible): Canary rollout slider (0–100), Auto-fallback toggles, Retry policy selector
  5) Create button with 2ndary "Create and open endpoint" option

MICROCOPY DRAFTS (button & tooltip text):
- Create endpoint button: "Create endpoint — quick launch"
- Pin version dropdown label: "Pin model version (optional)"
- Tooltip for pin: "Pinning fixes the model binary used by this endpoint. Unpinned endpoints auto-follow latest compatible minor releases."
- Compare header: "Snapshot differences that matter for production: latency, token cost, and licensing."
- Empty toolbar state: "Select a model to unlock quick actions"

PINNING UX DETAILS / EDGE CASES: 
- If user picks 2 models and attempts to pin both into single endpoint: disabled — show validation: "Can't pin multiple model families to one endpoint. Create separate endpoints or use Ensemble beta."
- If selected model has no compatible versions for target infra (e.g., quantized only for x86): show inline warning with link: "version incompatible with chosen capacity" -> open compatibility helper
- Pin change after creation: endpoint settings page should show timeline: pinned-on, pinned-by (user), reason (free text). Add audit log event.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (MVP):
- Toolbar appears reliably on selection across the catalog (unit tests around DOM), and selected model data is correct.
- Compare popup shows median latency, cost-per-1k-tokens, and embed-dim for each selected model.
- Create endpoint inline modal creates an endpoint with chosen name, capacity, and pin option; backend returns endpoint id and console navigates to endpoint details if user selected that option.
- Proper validation prevents pinning incompatible versions.

BACKLOG ITEMS (quick tickets to create):
- RLW-3012: Implement sticky selection toolbar + selection state plumbing (priority: high)
- RLW-3013: Compare popup component + metric aggregation API (priority: medium)
- RLW-3014: Endpoint compact modal + create endpoint API binding (priority: high)
- RLW-3015: Pin validation & audit log (priority: medium)
- RLW-3016: Microcopy pass + i18n prep (priority: low)

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED:
- Autosuggest endpoint naming: should we include model family + ecosystem tag by default? (Marco prefers short names).
- Should we allow multi-model create (create multiple endpoints from selection) in MVP? (Scope creep risk)
- Canary slider: numeric input or percentage only? Ask SRE for rollout semantics.

RISKS & MITIGATIONS: 
- Risk: Toolbar increases cognitive load for casual browsers. Mitigation: keep it minimal, hidden until selection and add quick 'x' to dismiss for session.
- Risk: Pinning language confuses users about "latest" vs "pinned". Mitigation: create onboarding tooltip on first-creation and endpoint detail indicator.

USER TESTING PLAN:
- Recruit 6 engineers (mix of ML infra + app dev) for 30-minute moderated sessions. Tasks: select 2 models, compare, create a dev endpoint pinned to a version. Observe confusion points around pin dropdown and capacity choices.
- Collect 5 task-completion metrics and 10 qualitative notes.

NEXT STEPS (owner = Aisha):
- Sweep microcopy with content team (Liang) and finalize button copy (due 2025-03-05).
- Spin up a quick Figma with two variants: toolbar left-aligned vs centered. Show in product sync 2025-03-03.
- Create JIRA tickets (listed above) and assign RLW-3014 to Marco for API contract.

NOTES / SCRATCHES: 
- "quick compare" should default to tokens @128 — that's the most common dev use-case.
- Might surface a small "cost estimate" per 1k tokens on the card (rounded). Could be toggled off in settings.
- If we later add ensembles, change CTA: "Create endpoint(s)" and allow multiple output targets.

---
Informal observations from whiteboard session (raw):
- Sophie: "Make the compare popup keyboard navigable — people will tab through metrics."
- Ethan: "Consider an 'experiment' flag so we can A/B show toolbar to new signups."
- Liang: "Copy: avoid technical words like 'KV cache' in catalog — keep to latency/cost/compatibility."

END OF NOTE.

- [ ] Write API contract draft (Marco)
- [ ] Run microcopy pass (Liang)
- [ ] Draft user test plan & recruit (Sophie)
